description: Per-prompt Claude Code activity from OTel log events: permission modes, skills, slash commands, tools and API requests.
title: Claude Prompts

panels.description: Developer prompts sent to Claude Code in the period.
panels.title: Prompts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Prompts"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

panels.description: Distinct Claude Code sessions that sent at least one prompt.
panels.title: Sessions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

panels.description: Prompts per day, split by the permission mode they ran in. 'default' includes sessions that never reported a mode change.
panels.title: Prompts per Day by Permission Mode

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  p.permission_mode AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)), p.permission_mode
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Total estimated cost of the prompts run in each permission mode.
panels.title: Estimated Cost by Permission Mode

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.permission_mode AS "Mode",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS "Cost (USD)"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY p.permission_mode
ORDER BY SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) DESC

panels.description: Share of input-side tokens served from the prompt cache: cache reads / (input + cache reads + cache writes). Higher is cheaper.
panels.title: Cache Read Share

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.cache_read_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(p.input_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens), 0) AS "Cache read share"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

panels.description: How many prompts made N API requests, and how many made N tool calls.
panels.title: Prompt Size Distribution

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.label AS "Calls per prompt",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.api_request_count BETWEEN b.lo AND b.hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "API requests",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.tool_call_count BETWEEN b.lo AND b.hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Tool calls"
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS ord, '0' AS label, 0 AS lo, 0 AS hi
  UNION ALL SELECT 1, '1', 1, 1
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, '2-3', 2, 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, '4-7', 4, 7
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, '8-15', 8, 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, '16-31', 16, 31
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, '32+', 32, 1000000000
) AS b
CROSS JOIN ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY b.ord, b.label
ORDER BY b.ord

panels.description: Wall-clock time from the prompt to its last recorded event, per day. Prompts with no model request, such as local slash commands, are excluded.
panels.title: Prompt Duration (p50 / p90)

targets.rawSql:
WITH durations AS (
  SELECT DATE(p.started_at) AS day,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, p.started_at, p.ended_at) / 1000000 AS secs
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND p.ended_at >= p.started_at
    AND p.api_request_count > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT day, secs, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY day, secs IS NULL ORDER BY secs) AS pr
  FROM durations
)
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.5 THEN secs END) AS "p50",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.9 THEN secs END) AS "p90"
FROM ranked
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY time

panels.description: API error rate = API errors / (requests + errors). Tool failure rate = failed tool results / tool calls. Tool rejection rate = rejected tool uses / (tool calls + rejections).
panels.title: Error and Rejection Rates

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.api_error_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.api_request_count + p.api_error_count), 0) AS "API error rate",
  SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0) AS "Tool failure rate",
  SUM(p.tool_reject_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count + p.tool_reject_count), 0) AS "Tool rejection rate"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Compares prompts that started at least one subagent with prompts that did not.
panels.title: Prompts With and Without Subagents

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN p.subagent_count > 0 THEN 'With subagents' ELSE 'No subagents' END AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count",
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Share",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / COUNT(*) AS "Cost per prompt",
  AVG(p.api_request_count) AS "API requests per prompt",
  AVG(p.tool_call_count) AS "Tool calls per prompt"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.subagent_count > 0 THEN 'With subagents' ELSE 'No subagents' END
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.description: Which model or combination of models each prompt used. '(no model request)' means the prompt made no API call, such as a local slash command.
panels.title: Models Used per Prompt

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.models_used, ''), '(no model request)') AS "Models",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.models_used, ''), '(no model request)')
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.description: Share of prompts that started with a slash command.
panels.title: Prompts Using a Slash Command

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(p.command_name <> '') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Share"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

panels.description: Share of prompts that used at least one skill.
panels.title: Prompts Using a Skill

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(p.used_skill) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Share"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

panels.description: Number of different skills used in the period.
panels.title: Distinct Skills Used

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.skill_name) AS "Skills"
FROM ai_prompt_skills s
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.session_id = s.session_id AND p.prompt_id = s.prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

panels.description: Average estimated cost of prompts that used a skill.
panels.title: Cost per Prompt With a Skill

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Cost"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND p.used_skill = 1

panels.description: Prompts per slash command.
panels.title: Slash Command Usage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CONCAT('/', p.command_name) AS "Command",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND p.command_name <> ''
GROUP BY p.command_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: Prompts per skill, split by how the skill was invoked. 'unknown' means it was only seen on an API request or Skill tool call.
panels.title: Top Skills by Trigger

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.skill_name AS "Skill",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'user-slash') AS "user-slash",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'claude-proactive') AS "claude-proactive",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'nested-skill') AS "nested-skill",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger NOT IN ('user-slash', 'claude-proactive', 'nested-skill')) AS "unknown"
FROM ai_prompt_skills s
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.session_id = s.session_id AND p.prompt_id = s.prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY s.skill_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: Share of prompts per day that used at least one skill.
panels.title: Skill Adoption

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.used_skill) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Prompts using a skill"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Prompts, cost and tokens per permission mode.
panels.title: Permission Mode Breakdown

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.permission_mode AS "Mode",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Share",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS "Cost",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / COUNT(*) AS "Cost per prompt",
  AVG(p.input_tokens + p.output_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens) AS "Tokens per prompt",
  AVG(p.tool_call_count) AS "Tool calls per prompt"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY p.permission_mode
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.description: Every permission mode switch, grouped by from mode, to mode and what triggered it. Running /plan counts as entering plan mode.
panels.title: Mode Transitions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.from_mode, ''), '(session start)') AS "From",
  m.to_mode AS "To",
  m.`trigger` AS "Trigger",
  COUNT(*) AS "Changes",
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
  AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(m.from_mode, ''), '(session start)'), m.to_mode, m.`trigger`
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.description: Whether a prompt's mode came from a reported mode change (observed) or was assumed to be 'default' because the session reported none (inferred).
panels.title: Mode Observed vs Inferred

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN p.permission_mode_inferred THEN 'Inferred' ELSE 'Observed' END AS "Mode source",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.permission_mode_inferred THEN 'Inferred' ELSE 'Observed' END

panels.description: Tool calls, failures, rejections and run time per tool. Duration percentiles cover completed calls.
panels.title: Tool Usage

targets.rawSql:
WITH results AS (
  SELECT e.tool_name, e.success, e.duration_ms,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY e.tool_name, e.duration_ms IS NULL ORDER BY e.duration_ms) AS pr
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
  AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND e.event_name = 'tool_result'
), rejects AS (
  SELECT e.tool_name, COUNT(*) AS rejected
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
  AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND e.event_name = 'tool_decision'
    AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.decision')) = 'reject'
  GROUP BY e.tool_name
)
SELECT r.tool_name AS "Tool",
  COUNT(*) AS "Calls",
  SUM(r.success = 0) AS "Failed",
  SUM(r.success = 0) / COUNT(*) AS "Failure rate",
  MAX(COALESCE(j.rejected, 0)) AS "Rejected",
  AVG(r.duration_ms) AS "Avg duration",
  MIN(CASE WHEN r.pr >= 0.5 THEN r.duration_ms END) AS "p50 duration",
  MIN(CASE WHEN r.pr >= 0.9 THEN r.duration_ms END) AS "p90 duration"
FROM results r
LEFT JOIN rejects j ON j.tool_name = r.tool_name
GROUP BY r.tool_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.description: Model request volume, cost and latency. TTFT is time to first token.
panels.title: API Requests by Model

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (
  SELECT e.model, e.query_source, e.event_timestamp, e.duration_ms, e.cost_usd,
    CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.ttft_ms')) AS DECIMAL(20, 3)) AS ttft_ms
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
  AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND e.event_name = 'api_request'
), ranked AS (
  SELECT model, duration_ms, ttft_ms, cost_usd,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY model, duration_ms IS NULL ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pr_duration,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY model, ttft_ms IS NULL ORDER BY ttft_ms) AS pr_ttft
  FROM requests
)
SELECT model AS "Model",
  COUNT(*) AS "Requests",
  SUM(cost_usd) AS "Cost",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr_duration >= 0.5 THEN duration_ms END) AS "p50 duration",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr_duration >= 0.9 THEN duration_ms END) AS "p90 duration",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr_ttft >= 0.5 THEN ttft_ms END) AS "p50 TTFT",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr_ttft >= 0.9 THEN ttft_ms END) AS "p90 TTFT"
FROM ranked
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.description: Daily request duration and time to first token across all models.
panels.title: API Latency (p50 / p90)

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (
  SELECT e.model, e.query_source, e.event_timestamp, e.duration_ms, e.cost_usd,
    CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.attributes, '$.ttft_ms')) AS DECIMAL(20, 3)) AS ttft_ms
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_events e
  WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
  AND e.connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.user_email, ''), e.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND e.event_name = 'api_request'
), ranked AS (
  SELECT DATE(event_timestamp) AS day, duration_ms, ttft_ms,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE(event_timestamp), duration_ms IS NULL ORDER BY duration_ms) AS pr_duration,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE(event_timestamp), ttft_ms IS NULL ORDER BY ttft_ms) AS pr_ttft
  FROM requests
)
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr_duration >= 0.5 THEN duration_ms END) AS "Duration p50",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr_duration >= 0.9 THEN duration_ms END) AS "Duration p90",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr_ttft >= 0.5 THEN ttft_ms END) AS "TTFT p50",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr_ttft >= 0.9 THEN ttft_ms END) AS "TTFT p90"
FROM ranked
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Per-user prompt volume, cost and habits.
panels.title: Prompt Usage by User

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(names.full_name, u.user) AS "User",
  u.team AS "Team",
  u.prompts AS "Prompts",
  u.sessions AS "Sessions",
  u.cost AS "Cost",
  u.cost / u.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  u.plan_share AS "Plan mode",
  u.skill_share AS "Used a skill",
  u.command_share AS "Slash command",
  u.tool_failure_rate AS "Tool failure rate"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.team_slug ORDER BY c.team_slug SEPARATOR ', ') AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    AVG(p.permission_mode = 'plan') AS plan_share,
    AVG(p.used_skill) AS skill_share,
    AVG(p.command_name <> '') AS command_share,
    SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0) AS tool_failure_rate
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = p.source_connection_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)
) u
LEFT JOIN (
  -- Resolve each email to a person's full name from accounts. gitextractor rows (id = email) are preferred;
  -- only names that look like a full name (contain a space) are used, otherwise the email is shown.
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a_n.email)) AS email_key,
         COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a_n.id = a_n.email THEN n_n.name END), MAX(n_n.name)) AS full_name
  FROM accounts a_n
  JOIN (SELECT id, TRIM(REPLACE(full_name, UNHEX('E2808B'), '')) AS name FROM accounts) n_n
    ON n_n.id = a_n.id AND n_n.name LIKE '% %' AND n_n.name NOT LIKE '%@%'
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(a_n.email), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(a_n.email))
) names ON names.email_key = LOWER(TRIM(u.user))
ORDER BY u.prompts DESC
